scripts.text:
[Leticia]
Okay, that's enough. It will open a passage to the place where the unholy energy is on the time seal seen there.
scripts.translation:
[萊蒂西婭]
好了，到此為止。它會在你看到的時間封印上開啟一道通往汙穢能量所在之處的通道。

scripts.text:
[Leticia]
Are you ready? Then extend your hand forward and keep your eyes on the seal as if you are focusing the power I'm giving you onto the seal.
scripts.translation:
[萊蒂西婭]
準備好了嗎？向前伸出手，注視封印，把我賦予你的力量集中到封印上。

scripts.text: Reach out hand and watch the seal
scripts.translation: 伸出手並注視封印

scripts.text:
[Leticia]
Now then, let's open the other one as well. Move to the site opposite this gate.
scripts.translation:
[萊蒂西婭]
那麼，我們也開啟另一個封印吧。去這道門對面的位置。

scripts.text:
[Leticia]
It's simpler than you think, isn't it?. With this, we'll be able to stop strange guys from flooding the garden until Oscar completes the mansion, so it's a relief.
scripts.translation:
[萊蒂西婭]
比你想像的簡單吧？這樣，在奧斯卡完成宅邸之前，我們就能阻止那些奇怪的傢伙湧入花園了，真讓人放心。

scripts.text:
[Leticia]
And since you've already helped me, from now on you'll have to work with me every day. It's no big deal. Reduce the number of unholy things in the dungeon under the passage created here.
scripts.translation:
[萊蒂西婭]
既然你已經幫過我，從現在起每天都要和我一起工作。沒什麼大不了的，把通道下方地牢裡的汙穢之物清理掉就行。

scripts.text: I think I've heard this before
scripts.translation: 我好像聽過這話

scripts.text:
[Leticia]
Why are you muttering? Do you have any complaints?
scripts.translation:
[萊蒂西婭]
你在嘀咕什麼？有什麼意見嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Leticia]
I think it's finished. Let's come to the central square for a moment and talk about the next thing.
scripts.translation:
[萊蒂西婭]
事情應該辦妥了。我們去中央廣場聊聊接下來的事吧。

scripts.text:
[Terremotus]
^777700Oh, the adventurer Leticia sent has finally arrived.
scripts.translation:
[泰雷莫圖斯]
^777700哦，萊蒂西婭派來的冒險者終於到了。

scripts.text:
[Ardor]
^aa0000Adventurer! Are you willing to fight? We don't need a weakling!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾多]
^aa0000冒險者！你願意戰鬥嗎？我們不需要弱者！

scripts.text:
[Diluvio]
^0000ffArdor! Have you forgotten what Leticia told you to be at least polite?
scripts.translation:
[迪盧維奧]
^0000ff阿爾多！你忘了萊蒂西婭讓你至少要有禮貌嗎？

scripts.text:
[Procella]
^00cc00Diluvio is right. It would be good to show some courtesy to the humans who come to help us.
scripts.translation:
[普羅切拉]
^00cc00迪盧維奧說得對。對前來幫助我們的人類，應該表示些敬意。

scripts.text: I'm fine, please tell me what to do
scripts.translation: 我沒事，請告訴我該做什麼

scripts.text:
[Serpens]
^aa00aaWe are ancient spirits from a world connected to this garden. It is an instinct engraved in our spirit bodies to help each natural element remain harmonious.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾彭斯]
^aa00aa我們是來自與這座花園相連世界的古老精靈。幫助各個自然元素維持和諧，是銘刻在我們靈體中的本能。

scripts.text:
[Serpens]
^aa00aaHowever, after being swept away by a strange dimensional storm, the elements of the world connected to this garden began to run wild, and eventually began to turn into spirits.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾彭斯]
^aa00aa然而，一場奇異的空間風暴將我們捲走後，與花園相連世界中的元素開始失控，最終逐漸化為精靈。

scripts.text:
[Terremotus]
^777700If the elements continue to become elementals, eventually the material world that makes up this world will collapse. That must be prevented.
scripts.translation:
[泰雷莫圖斯]
^777700如果元素繼續化為元素精靈，構成這個世界的物質終將崩潰。我們必須阻止這一切。

scripts.text:
[Diluvio]
^0000ffAdventurer, you must no longer allow the elements to turn into spirits. Use your power to send them back to nature.
scripts.translation:
[迪盧維奧]
^0000ff冒險者，不能再讓元素化為精靈了。請用你的力量讓它們迴歸自然。

scripts.text:
[Terremotus]
^777700This is not an act of destroying nature. It is a matter of returning the disappearing elements that have been transformed into spirits back to their original positions. Will you listen to our request?
scripts.translation:
[泰雷莫圖斯]
^777700這並非破壞自然，而是將已經化為精靈、正逐漸消失的元素送回原位。你願意聽聽我們的請求嗎？

scripts.text: I will.
scripts.translation: 我願意

scripts.text:
[Ardor]
^aa0000You're a good communicator! Okay then, I'll tell you what to do every day!^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿爾多]
^aa0000您真會溝通！那麼，我每天都會告訴您該做什麼！^000000

scripts.text:
[Ardor]
^aa0000Let's place the sacred items prepared by the constellations across from us. In human language, it's called a vending machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿爾多]
^aa0000把星座們準備的神聖物品放到我們對面吧。用人類的話來說，那叫自動售貨機。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ardor]
^aa0000The reward for helping us and the constellations' work here will be received through that sacred item.^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿爾多]
^aa0000幫助我們以及星座們在此處工作的報酬，都可以通過那件神聖物品領取。^000000
